projects.title: CareerForge
projects.tagline: AI-powered career management — resumes, job tracking, and tailoring in one platform.
projects.description: A full-stack SaaS platform for professional profile management, AI-assisted resume analysis and tailoring, versioned resumes, PDF export, job application tracking, and subscription billing. Built as a modular monolith with Java 21, Spring Boot, Vue.js 3, PostgreSQL, and Docker.
projects.problem: Job seekers manage their career across disconnected tools — one for resumes, another for applications, another for AI rewrites. There is no single place to maintain a master professional profile and generate tailored resume versions for specific roles without losing previous versions.
projects.approach: Designed a modular monolith (not microservices) to keep deployment simple while maintaining clear internal boundaries. The core model separates a user's master professional profile from individual resume versions — allowing tailoring without destroying the original. AI analysis and tailoring use a provider abstraction so the underlying model can be swapped without restructuring the application. Billing uses the same abstraction pattern with a Stripe integration behind a BillingService interface.
projects.outcome: MVP delivered through production Docker build and CI/CD pipeline. 379 backend tests and 167 frontend tests passing. Features shipped: JWT authentication with refresh tokens, professional profile, versioned resume builder, AI resume analysis and tailoring, server-side PDF export (OpenPDF), job application tracker with status lifecycle, Stripe subscription billing, and a dashboard.

projects.title: AI-Powered Enterprise Asset Management Platform (EAMS)
projects.tagline: Full-stack EAM platform — assets, maintenance, inventory, and work orders in one system.
projects.description: A full-stack Enterprise Asset Management platform built from scratch using Java 21, Spring Boot, Vue.js 3, PostgreSQL, and Docker. Manages asset lifecycle, preventive maintenance schedules, inventory tracking, work orders, role-based access control, and AI-assisted maintenance intelligence.
projects.problem: Organizations managing physical assets still rely on spreadsheets or disconnected legacy systems for maintenance schedules, inventory, and work orders. These approaches make it impossible to enforce access control, track asset history, or scale operations without manual overhead.
projects.approach: Designed a modular Spring Boot architecture with clear domain boundaries — assets, maintenance, inventory, work orders, and users are separate modules with well-defined interfaces. Vue.js 3 frontend with JWT-based authentication and role-based access control. Flyway manages schema migrations. Dockerized infrastructure with GitHub Actions CI/CD. AI layer provides maintenance recommendations based on asset history and usage patterns.
projects.outcome: Production-ready platform supporting full asset lifecycle management, preventive maintenance scheduling, inventory tracking, work order management, and administrative capabilities. Serves as both a reusable enterprise platform and a demonstration of end-to-end product ownership.

faq.question: Are you currently available for new projects?
faq.answer: Yes — I am currently available for new engagements. I typically take on 1–2 projects at a time to ensure full focus. If your timeline is flexible, reach out early to reserve a slot.

faq.question: Do you work remotely?
faq.answer: Yes, fully remote. I am based in India (UTC+5:30) and have worked with clients across Europe, the US, and Southeast Asia. I schedule overlap hours to match your team's working day.

faq.question: What engagement models do you offer?
faq.answer: Fixed-price projects for well-scoped work, hourly for audits and reviews, retainer for ongoing support, and consulting for architecture and advisory. Most greenfield builds are fixed-price after a scoping call.

faq.question: How long does a typical project take?
faq.answer: A backend API takes 2–8 weeks. A full-stack product build is 4–16 weeks. Enterprise multi-tenant platforms run 8–24 weeks. Duration depends on scope, not padding — I scope honestly before committing.

faq.question: What is your primary tech stack?
faq.answer: Backend: Java 21 + Spring Boot 3. Frontend: Vue 3 + TypeScript. Database: PostgreSQL. Cloud: AWS (ECS, RDS, Lambda). CI/CD: Jenkins + Docker. I also work with Kafka, Redis, and OpenAI API for AI-assisted systems.

faq.question: Can you work on an existing codebase?
faq.answer: Yes. I regularly join projects mid-flight — rescuing systems that have outgrown their original design, adding features to legacy codebases, or improving performance. I always start with a codebase audit before touching anything.

faq.question: Do you sign NDAs and assign IP?
faq.answer: Yes to both. All client work is covered by a mutual NDA and full IP assignment. You own everything built during the engagement. I retain no rights to your code, data, or business logic.

faq.question: How do you communicate during a project?
faq.answer: Async-first via Slack or email for daily updates. Weekly video calls for progress reviews. I write clear status updates so you always know where things stand — no chasing required.

faq.question: What AI/LLM experience do you have?
faq.answer: I have built production LLM pipelines using OpenAI function calling + Spring Batch, reducing manual document review by 70%. I work with GPT-4o, embeddings, pgvector semantic search, and confidence-scored human review queues.

faq.question: How do I start a project with you?
faq.answer: Send an email or book a 30-minute call via Calendly. We discuss your requirements, I ask clarifying questions, and within 48 hours I send a written scope, timeline, and fixed price. No obligation until you sign.
